questions.stem: Breakthrough bleeding is the most common problem with:
questions.solutionHtml:
Progesterone-only pill
  • Breakthrough bleeding is the most common problem with Progesterone-only Episodes of irregular, unpredictable spotting and breakthrough bleeding are the most frequently encountered untoward effect and the major reason women discontinue the use of progesterone-only contraceptives.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:348,350.

questions.stem: The following are the non-contraceptive benefits of OCPs Except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Cervical cancer
  • An increased incidence of vaginal, cervical, and breast cancers is seen with the use of OCPs.

questions.stem: If a woman on combined pills missed 3 tablets in week 1 after HFI during the cycle, What should she do for contraception?

options.label: A
options.text: Take two tablets the next day and continue the remaining pill as usual.

options.label: B
options.text: Take the missed pill as soon as possible and continue the remaining pill as usual, consider EC if UPSI has taken place.

options.label: C
options.text: Manage as a new start contraception

options.label: D
options.text: Take the missed pill as soon as possible and continue the remaining pill as usual, EC is not required even if UPSI has taken place.

questions.answerText: Take the missed pill as soon as possible and continue the remaining pill as usual, consider EC if UPSI has taken place.
questions.solutionHtml:
Take the missed pill as soon as possible and continue the remaining pill as usual, consider EC if UPSI has taken place.
  • As the patient has missed 3 pills in week 1 she should Take the missed pill as soon as possible and continue the remaining pill as usual, consider EC if UPSI has taken place(As week 1 is the most important phase to suppress ovulation).


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 350.

questions.stem: A Woman on combined OCPs was taking it irregularly in a cycle. She became pregnant and what advice did you give to her:
questions.solutionHtml:
Termination of pregnancy
  • If pregnancy occurs during the use of hormonal contraceptives it should be terminated by suction-aspiration because the risk of malformations, genital carcinoma in female offspring, and undescended testes in male offspring is increased.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 350

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a complication of the use of oral contraceptives:
questions.solutionHtml:
Intracranial hemorrhage
  • Oral Contraceptive Pills can cause thromboembolic complications not hemorrhagic.

questions.stem: Prolonged testosterone treatment for a man results in:
questions.solutionHtml:
Azoospermia
  • Continuous and prolonged use of GnRH agonists and gonadal hormones (testosterone, estrogen) leads to suppression of gonadal function due to inhibition of LH and FSH resulting in decreased sperm production(Azoospermia) and testicular size.
  • Since this effect is usually reversible, it is investigated as a therapeutic approach for male contraception.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 324
